The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand how search engines work, imagine the Internet as a massive, endless library. In this library, every website is like a distinct book, and each individual web page is a specific page within that book. If you were looking for a specific fact in a physical library, you would use the library’s index or catalog system to locate the exact book and page. Similarly, a search engine like Google acts as that intelligent index, scanning the vast "library" of the Internet to help you pinpoint the exact website and page that holds the information you are looking for.
